name: onyx
description: Premium macOS comic reader built with Electron and React

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-mac-icon.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.build:mac:intel: node scripts/generate-mac-icon.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --config .electron-builder.config.js --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:apple: node scripts/generate-mac-icon.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --config .electron-builder.config.js --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:all: node scripts/generate-mac-icon.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --config .electron-builder.config.js --mac dmg --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/generate-mac-icon.mjs && vite build && electron-builder --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish always
